name: Evangelion 90s
summary: Mid-90s TV cels with hard shadow, a purple-green-orange signal palette, harsh summer light, long held stills and black title cards in compressed white serif.

traits.line: thin dark lines, slender figures (Yoshiyuki Sadamoto designs)
traits.shading: hard two-tone cel shadow, occasional airbrushed highlight on mecha
traits.palette: purple and lime green, red and orange, white and blue; orange sunset skies and blood-orange fluid; NERV red warning colours
traits.lighting: harsh cicada-summer daylight and long shadows versus dim command rooms lit by monitors
traits.faces: readable-at-a-glance designs; medium-large eyes, small mouths, subtle mixed expressions
traits.backgrounds: painted suburban streets, telephone poles and wires, rail crossings, geofront interiors
traits.camera: long held still frames, telephoto silhouettes, cross-shaped explosions; black cards of white Matisse EB serif type, mechanically compressed

style_words: Mid-1990s TV cel animation, as in Neon Genesis Evangelion (1995): thin dark lines, hard two-tone cel shading, purple-and-lime, red-and-orange signal palette, harsh summer daylight and long shadows, orange sunset skies, painted streets of telephone poles and wires, long held still frames, black cards of compressed white serif type, cel grain.
avoid: text elements turning into garbled fake lettering

krea2.style: Mid-1990s TV cel animation, as in Neon Genesis Evangelion: thin dark lines, slender figures, hard two-tone cel shading, purple-and-lime and red-and-orange signal palette, harsh summer daylight with long hard shadows, orange sunset skies, telephone poles and wires, long held still frames, hand-painted cels with grain, plain unmarked surfaces.
krea2.recap: Drawn throughout as mid-1990s TV cel animation with hard two-tone cel shading and cel grain.

flux3_klein.style: Mid-1990s TV anime cel animation in the register of Neon Genesis Evangelion: thin dark lines, slender figures, readable-at-a-glance faces with medium-large eyes and small mouths, hard two-tone cel shadows with crisp edges, long hard cast shadows, flat opaque hand-painted cels, painted backgrounds with plain unmarked surfaces, cel grain and video-era softness.
flux3_klein.recap: Orange and red fill the sky and the light sources, white and blue fill the walls and the ground, purple and lime green appear only in the shadow fills and the rim light, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is a mid-1990s TV cel animation frame in a signature Neon Genesis Evangelion style, with thin dark lines and slender figures, flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes in two tones, occasional airbrushed highlights, cel grain and soft video-era haze, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of purple and lime green, red and orange signal colours, with white, blue and orange sunset tones.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition is held like a long still frame with harsh light, long shadows and telephoto flatness, in a tense, uneasy mood, keeps to a palette of purple and lime green, red and orange signal colours, with white, blue and orange sunset tones, and reads throughout as a mid-1990s TV cel animation frame in a signature Neon Genesis Evangelion style, with thin dark lines and slender figures, flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes in two tones, occasional airbrushed highlights, cel grain and soft video-era haze.
